## README

 slop-filter 

The goal of this project is to collectively pursue an internet without having to sift through slop. It doesn't end at posts on X or comments on Reddit. It also means blocking bot accounts, YouTube and TikTok videos with AI-generated scripts, and whatever comes next.

Today it is a Chrome and Firefox extension that hides AI-generated posts and comments on X, LinkedIn, and Reddit, and comments and videos on YouTube. A video is judged by its script, never by its title or thumbnail.

Slop Filter scanning posts on X and LinkedIn: a scan line runs over each post, then it turns green and stays or red and folds away, while a side panel counts posts scanned, slop caught, request time, and cost.

## What it does

- Scores every post in your feed for how likely it is to be AI-written.
- Collapses the ones over your threshold. One click shows a post again.

# Reddit LLM Comment Detector

A browser extension that uses machine learning to detect AI-generated comments on Reddit. Built with 🤗 Transformers.js for client-side inference.

## 🎯 What It Does

This extension analyzes Reddit comments in real-time to identify content that may have been generated by Large Language Models (AI). It provides:

- **🚨 Visual highlighting** of potentially AI-generated comments
- **📊 User scoring system** that tracks AI detection percentages for individual users 
- **🎨 Color-coded risk levels** (green/orange/red based on AI percentage)
- **💾 Persistent tracking** across browsing sessions
- **⚡ Real-time analysis** as you browse Reddit
- **🎛️ Customizable aggression levels** from passive highlighting to auto-minimizing AI comments

# Reddit’s Spam Crackdown: Protecting the Community or Self-Interest? 

 Reddit says it’s fighting spam across two layers – but there is a third one, unnamed. 

 Seth Matthews July 24, 2026 

## Key Takeaways:

- Reddit deploys LLM to fight LLM: new defenses evaluate meaning, rather than surface tells.
- The new system targets three layers of inauthenticity: bot mechanics, AI filler, and content written to be quoted by AI engines.
- Reddit’s announcement never explicitly mentions GEO: it describes it without labeling it.
- ~$200 million in licensing deals rest on authenticity: Reddit’s incentive is commercial before it is communal.

Executive Summary: Reddit’s July 2026 update announced LLM-powered defenses against LLM-generated spam and manipulative behavior. The familiar anti-bot language obscures what is likely a real target: content written to be cited inside AI answers. With roughly $200 million in data licensing, the move seems aimed at protecting the product more than the community..
